moves.name:
Almighty Roar
Hyper Beam
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When an ally’s Pokémon uses any moves 3 times.
Deactivation Condition: Cannot be deactivated.

Never misses. The more the opponent’s Defense or Sp. Def are lowered, the greater the power of this attack.

moves.name:
Let’s Get
Serious!
moves.description: Raises the user’s Attack and Sp. Atk by 6 stat ranks. Raises the user’s critical-hit rate by 3 stat ranks. Applies the Gradual Healing effect to the user. Applies the Enduring effect to the user. The user takes damage equal to 20% of its remaining HP.

moves.name:

Outrage
moves.description: The more the target’s Sp. Def is lowered, the greater the power of this attack.

passives.name: Draco Myth
passives.description: Powers up the moves of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits ]%. Reduces attack move damage taken by all allied sync pairs by [Digit:2digits Idx="1" ]%. The more allied sync pairs with [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] you have on your team, the higher these percentages are. (Each additional sync pair powers up moves by 10% and reduces damage by 3%. The maximum power-up is [Digit:2digits Idx="3" ]%, and the maximum damage reduction is [Digit:2digits Idx="4" ]%.)

passives.name: Draco Judgment
passives.description: Raises the [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] of all allied sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] the first time the user enters a battle each battle. Lowers the [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] of all opposing sync pairs by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] the first time the user enters a battle each battle.

passives.name: Your Challenge Ends with Me!
passives.description: Lowers the target’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="1" S="rank" P="ranks" ] when the user’s physical attack move against it is successful. Lowers the target’s [Name:ReferencedMessageTag Idx="2" ] by [Digit:1digit Idx="3" ] stat [EN:Qty Ref="3" S="rank" P="ranks" ] when the user’s special attack move against it is successful.

passives.name: The Caped Dragon Master
passives.description: Normal-type moves become [Name:ReferencedMessageTag ]-type moves. Decreases the amount of move gauge slots the user’s Pokémon needs to use moves by [Digit:1digit Idx="1" ]. The user’s moves never miss.

passives.name: We’ve Been through Enough
passives.description: Reduces damage when the user is hit by an attack move or sync move when its HP is full. Restores the user’s HP when its attack move is successful.
